store.description:
The conversation store: a file name (a plain <name>.json, nothing else) in ~/.local/state/lares/llm/ (the mockup keeps its
own, mockup_conversations.json). Read as the shell starts.

Takes a text like conversations.json. Default: "conversations.json". Read as the shell starts.

notePrompt.description:
The text put in the chat's composer, SELECTED (one Backspace or any typing replaces it), when a note is sent to the chat from
its right-click menu "Send to LLM". Any text; "" = none.

Takes a text. Default: "".

systemPrompt.description:
Told to the model at the start of every chat (the language to answer in, how long, what machine this is). "" = nothing. It takes room
of the context.

Takes a text. Default: "".

url.description: Takes a text like http://localhost:11434. Default: "http://localhost:11434". Read as the shell starts.

protocol.description: Takes "ollama" or "openai". Default: "ollama". Read as the shell starts.

server.description:
THE SERVER the chat talks to: its address, and whether it speaks Ollama's own protocol or OpenAI's ("ollama" | "openai"). With an address
that is not this machine (the laptop using the desktop: "http://desktop:11434") nothing is done to this machine's GPU or CPU for the
chat, and the GPU's memory is not shown. Read as the shell starts.

unloadAfterMin.description:
Minutes the model stays loaded after the chat is closed. 0: let go at once. -1: until you unload it. 0 .. 1440.

Takes a number -1 .. 1440. Default: 0.

think.x-wants: true or false, or an object
think.description:
Whether a model that can think first does: true | false, or per model: { "qwen3:8b": false } (a model not named thinks).

Takes true or false, or an object. Default: true.

default.description:
The context of a model you have not tuned in the model picker, in tokens, or "auto" (as large as the GPU's memory takes: it is
measured when the model is first used).

Takes "auto", or a whole number 512 .. 1048576. Default: 4096.

autoMax.description:
"auto" gives a small model (8 B parameters at most) never more than this many tokens (4096 at least), and leaves this much of the
GPU's memory free (MiB, 768 at least). Changed, a model is measured again at its next use.

Takes a whole number 4096 .. 1048576. Default: 32768.

on.description:
The tools are on when the shell starts (the wrench in the composer).

Takes true or false. Default: false.

off.description:
Tools that are never offered, by name ("web_search", "screenshot", "run_command" ...: `ls llm_tools` in the shell's folder).

Takes a list of texts. Default: [].

ask.description:
Tools that ask first though they only read ("web_search", "screenshot", "clipboard_read", "read_file" ...). A tool that acts always asks.

Takes a list of texts. Default: [].

rounds.description:
How many rounds of tool calls one answer may take, and how many calls one round. 1 .. 40, 1 .. 32.

Takes a whole number 1 .. 40. Default: 12.

searchUrl.description:
The SearXNG that web_search asks, and how many results it hands over. 1 .. 20.

Takes a text like http://127.0.0.1:8888. Default: "http://127.0.0.1:8888".

history.description:
The list of conversations when the chat opens: "session" (shut at the shell's start, then as you left it) | "closed" | "open".

Takes "session", "closed" or "open". Default: "session".

titles.description:
A new conversation's title: "model" (the model is asked, once) | "words" (the first words of what you wrote).

Takes "model" or "words". Default: "model".

maxConversations.description:
The most conversations kept; past it the oldest that is not pinned goes. Read as the shell starts. A smaller number deletes the rest.

Takes a whole number 1 .. 10000. Default: 200. Read as the shell starts.

attachFrom.description:
The folder the attach button's file chooser starts in.

Takes a path. Default: "~".

model.description:
The model that answers it; "" = the chat's current one.

Takes a text. Default: "".

copy.description:
A short answer is put on the clipboard.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

autoRun.description:
The few commands that only read run without asking. false: every one asks.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

dropMin.description:
A command nobody answered about is dropped after this many minutes. 1 .. 240.

Takes a number 1 .. 240. Default: 10.

machine.description: While the model answers the CPU's power profile is held at least at "balanced" | "none" (nothing is held).
